historical_reviews.deepseek: The sensor-get name is directionally relevant, but it neither proves the Web row nor maps the switch VR, and the requested IBC evidence belongs to the later duplicate identity.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Correctly retains UI authority and requires physical switch-VR mapping plus complete field validation.
historical_reviews.history: The row-1878 TEMP_UBB_IBC IPMI case is a separate Source Identity; its IBC component and acceptance rules cannot substitute here.
historical_reviews.v3_1: TEMP_SW_VR must be distinguished from the switch-chip sensors in the prior row: it represents the switch voltage-regulator thermal domain, not the ASIC junction. Comparing it to chip limits or mapping it to UBB IBC would be semantically wrong even if all values use degrees Celsius.

original_test_intent: Verify that the BMC Web Sensor List correctly represents the switch voltage-regulator temperature resource, including its physical regulator domain, live value, units, health, thresholds and SPEC limits, without conflating it with switch-chip or UBB IBC telemetry.
original_method: Confirm the platform's switch-VR component and approved sensor mapping, open the protected Web Sensor List, record page context and refresh, locate the exact TEMP_SW_VR row, capture all fields, compare the regulator-specific range and thresholds to the SPEC, optionally correlate the same backend source, and retain evidence without changing cooling, thresholds or logs.
manual_activity: A platform thermal reviewer confirms that the rendered row maps to the switch voltage regulator—not the switch ASIC or IBC—and validates its UI fields against the correct component SPEC.
required_inputs: Switch board and regulator physical map
Regulator-specific units, thresholds and valid range
safety_requirements: Do not modify switch, regulator, thresholds, cooling, power or firmware
Verify regulator rather than ASIC identity
Reject UBB IBC evidence from duplicate row 1878
Record absent, duplicate and stale states
Do not apply chip temperature limits to VR data
agent_execution_scope: Verify target, Web route and regulator topology
Validate physical mapping and telemetry source
Compare value, unit, health, thresholds, timestamp and regulator-specific range
engineer_actions: Approve switch-VR component mapping and SPEC
Visually confirm the Web row and context
Resolve missing, stale or ambiguous regulator identity

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: `sensor get TEMP_SW_VR` can corroborate the backend resource, but the truncated fallback and TEMP_UBB_IBC expected output do not cover the Web UI or the correct component identity.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use the protected BMC-Web Sensor List to capture the complete TEMP_SW_VR row and prove its switch-regulator mapping against the proper SPEC; use a full supported backend read only to verify the same telemetry source.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The switch-VR Web inspection and 3/3-minute estimate remain; generic clearing, UBB IBC substitution and chip-limit reuse are excluded.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Bind the UI label/member to the regulator schematic/BOM identity and capture value, units, health, thresholds, timestamp, refresh context and regulator-specific limit outcome in one evidence object.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds component-level semantic disambiguation to the generic Sensor List check.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A plausible temperature named TEMP_SW_VR cannot prove it belongs to the intended regulator or uses the correct VR limits, especially alongside separate switch-chip telemetry.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: The Web label may aggregate multiple regulator phases; such aggregation is acceptable only when documented by the platform SPEC and backend mapping.

project_override_considerations: The Project must define the regulator(s) represented by TEMP_SW_VR and the correct VR thermal limits, separately from prior TEMP_SWITCH0~1 chip sensors and later TEMP_UBB_IBC. A backend-only substitute needs an approved UI-equivalence decision.
expected_evidence: Target/firmware/Web route, switch board/regulator identity and VR SPEC
Protected browser/session details with secrets redacted
Complete TEMP_SW_VR UI capture with filter/refresh context
Telemetry-source/physical mapping, reading, unit, health, thresholds, timestamp and VR-range comparison
Approved backend correlation and explicit component-disambiguation result

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, Web procedure and SPEC criterion coherently target the switch-VR sensor. The DeepSeek UBB IBC output and generic clear instruction are reference/method defects, not competing source coverage.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The regulator mapping, SPEC and protected UI are identifiable inputs. Execution becomes BLOCKED if TEMP_SW_VR cannot be distinguished from switch-chip or other board telemetry after the normal package request.

review_improvement: Makes the thermal component identity explicit, preventing correct-looking switch-chip or UBB IBC data from falsely satisfying the switch-regulator Web test.
independent_technical_reasoning: Temperature validity depends on the monitored physical component and its limits. Switch ASIC junction, voltage-regulator and board IBC sensors have different locations, dynamics and thresholds. Therefore name presence and numeric plausibility are insufficient; the UI resource must be bound to the regulator telemetry source and evaluated against regulator-specific semantics.
